notes: Fixed readings and English renderings for Shingeki no Kyojin. The build matches longer forms first, so names and corps stay consistent across episodes.

entries.note: The human-eating giants. In this series the word is a name, not the ordinary word for a large person.

entries.reading: ちょうおおがたきょじん
entries.note: The enormous Titan that broke the outer gates at Shiganshina and later at Trost.
The Titan's name. The series title in English is Attack on Titan.

entries.reading: りったいきどうそうち
entries.note: Omni-directional mobility gear. The harness and cables soldiers use to move through a city.
The regiment that rides outside the walls.
The regiment that defends the walls and the towns.
The regiment that keeps order inside the walls.
The cadet corps. Eren, Mikasa, and Armin trained here together.
In this series, one of the three concentric walls, not an ordinary garden wall.
The outermost wall. It has already fallen.
The middle wall. Trost is one of its districts.
The innermost wall.
Eren's hometown, and the place of Grisha's basement.
The district whose outer gate is broken in this episode.

forms: ミカサ・アッカーマン
entries.reading: ミカサ・アッカーマン

forms: アルミン・アルレルト
entries.reading: アルミン・アルレルト

forms: ジャン・キルシュタイン
entries.reading: ジャン・キルシュタイン

forms: コニー・スプリンガー
entries.reading: コニー・スプリンガー

forms: ベルトルト・フーバー
entries.reading: ベルトルト・フーバー

entries.note: Commander of the Garrison in the southern territory.
A cold political idea: cutting the population because there is not enough food. The episode treats it as a threat, not a plan to copy.
Taking back land that was lost. Here, Wall Maria.
The decision to act without a promise of success.
The small group of skilled soldiers asked to draw the Titans off Eren's road.
A planned military action, such as plugging the gate or the expedition beyond the walls.
Ian Dietrich, a leader of the Garrison elites during the Trost operation.
Mitabi Jarnach, one of the elite squad leaders at Trost.
Rico Brzenska, the elite leader who lives through the boulder operation.
Commander of the Military Police Brigade.
The officer who presides over Eren's hearing.
One of the two Titans Hange keeps for experiments.
The other captured Titan, paired with Sawney.

entries.reading: とくべつさくせんはん
entries.note: Levi's small squad, assigned to watch Eren and, if needed, to kill him.
Levi's rank in the Survey Corps.
The officer in charge of a regiment. Erwin is Commander of the Survey Corps.
A Titan that does not move like the others. On the expedition, one of them is hunting.

entries.reading: ちょうきょりさくてきじんけい
entries.note: The wide formation the Survey Corps uses outside the walls so a few soldiers can see danger early.
Hange's tests on captured Titans, and later on Eren's transformation.
The military hearing that decides who will have custody of Eren.
Hitch Dreyse, a Military Police recruit stationed near Annie.
Marlo Freudenberg, a Military Police recruit who still treats the rules as real.
The ability to harden a Titan's body. Eren trains it to plug the hole in Wall Maria.
The capital inside Wall Sina. The escort story says Eren is being taken there.
The government inside the walls. The Survey Corps cannot treat it as a simple ally.
The public story: Eren is escorted through Stohess. The real purpose is a trap.
The underground passage in Stohess. A Titan would have little room to appear there.
Bodies left by the expedition. Not every one of them can be carried home.
Unaccounted for. Not confirmed dead, and not returned.
A heavy strike. Here it is also what a failed best plan feels like.
The side that lost. After the expedition, the Survey Corps uses the word for itself.
Holding back a killing blow. The delay is paid for by other soldiers.
Annie's expression, which does not match the request being made of her.
Harm done to Stohess and the people living there.
People who live in the district and did not agree to a battlefield.
Humankind inside the walls, the thing the operation claims to protect.
The threat held over Eren, and over the Survey Corps, if the operation fails.
The back of the neck, where a soldier cuts a Titan.
A soldier from the same training class.
A Titan that is not mindless. It can speak, and it throws.
Mike Zacharias, a Survey Corps squad leader who meets the Beast Titan.
A Survey Corps soldier at Utgard Castle.
A Survey Corps soldier who holds the tower at Utgard.
A Survey Corps soldier beside Nanaba at Utgard.
A Garrison soldier from Shiganshina who stays near Eren.
Pastor Nick. He has seen what is inside the wall and does not explain it freely.
Hange's aide.
A warrior Ymir remembers. His choice is part of why she is still here.
Historia's family name, hidden under the name Christa.
A ruined castle. The 104th spends a night there without enough gear.
Connie's village. The people are gone, and there is no hole in the wall to explain it.
The name Reiner uses for himself and Bertholdt. It is not the same as soldier.
The power in Eren's scream that can turn other Titans.
Where a person is from. For the warriors, it is outside the walls.
A church official. Nick is one, and he is keeping a wall secret.
Kenny Ackerman. He leads the interior squad that hunts Eren and Historia, and he once raised Levi.
Rod Reiss, lord of the Reiss family and Historia's father.
Frieda Reiss, Historia's half-sister. She held the power inside the walls before Grisha.
Uri Reiss. Kenny's memory of him is a friendship, not only a chain.
Grisha Yeager, Eren's father. His past is outside the walls, and his basement is still locked.
Carla Yeager, Eren's mother.
Zeke Yeager. The Beast Titan has a name, and that name is Grisha's other son.
Dina Fritz, from a royal line in Marley. Grisha's first wife.
Keith Shadis. He watched Grisha arrive, and he watched Eren grow up from the side.
Dimo Reeves, head of the Reeves company in Trost.
Flegel Reeves, Dimo's son. He chooses to speak in public.
Sannes, an interior military policeman. He knows how the government keeps its secrets.
Floch Forster, a recruit who survives the charge at Shiganshina.
Kuchel Ackerman, Levi's mother and Kenny's sister.
A bloodline the Reiss family could not control with the Founding Titan. Levi, Mikasa, and Kenny share it.
A district on Wall Sina. Rod's Titan crawls toward it.
The nation across the sea. It keeps Eldians inside internment zones.
The people Marley calls devils, and the name of the old empire. The walls are what is left of it.
Grisha's basement in Shiganshina. The key has been waiting since the fall of Wall Maria.
A new explosive spear made to crack armor.
The informer inside Marley who chooses Grisha.
People who fled Shiganshina after Wall Maria fell.
The night the Training Corps finishes and the top cadets choose a regiment.
The cadet ranking. The top ten may apply to the Military Police.
A district gate in the wall. Breaking it lets Titans into the town.
Thomas Wagner, a cadet in Eren's first squad at Trost.
The red scarf Eren gives Mikasa. She keeps it on in battle.
Eren Kruger, the Owl. He passes the Attack Titan to Grisha.
The coordinate. It answers royal blood, and Grisha takes it from Frieda.
Falco Grice, a Marley warrior candidate. He wants the Armored Titan so Gabi will not inherit it.
Gabi Braun, Reiner's cousin and a warrior candidate. She fights to be seen as useful to Marley.
Colt Grice, Falco's older brother and a warrior candidate.
Udo, a warrior candidate beside Gabi on the Marley front.
Zofia, a warrior candidate. She keeps the group's numbers and stays near Udo.
Pieck Finger, holder of the Cart Titan.
Porco Galliard, holder of the Jaw Titan. He does not hide his contempt for Reiner.
Theo Magath, a Marley officer who commands the warrior candidates in the field.
The internment zone in Marley where the warriors' families live.
Willy Tybur. He speaks for the family that kept a Titan out of Marley's wars.
The Tybur family. They hold a noble place in Marley and a Titan the army does not command.
A Titan that builds weapons from its own body. The person need not sit in the nape.
A Marley volunteer who comes to the island with Zeke's plan and treats the Survey Corps as allies.
A volunteer engineer. He keeps the airship and the machines running for the island.
